sentences.cn: 几天之后，罗森博格接到珠宝商的电话，说马约莉生前订了一份礼物送给他——一枚结婚戒指。

trans.cn: 长途电话
长途电话：指打出特定地区的电话，通常有不同于本地电话的区号或冠码。长途电话一般会收取额外的费用，视提供服务的公司而定，且常受市场竞争等因素影响。

sentences.c: Mr. Thomas is making a long-distance call.
sentences.cn: 托马斯先生正在将长途电话。

sentences.c: I made a long-distance call to my wife, asking her to sell our house.
sentences.cn: 我给妻子打了通长途电话，让她卖掉我们的房子。

sentences.c: Even today, many find it hard to keep people of that generation on a long-distance call for very long-they still hear a meter ticking in their head and rush to finish.
sentences.cn: 即使是在今天，很多人都会发现，我们爷爷那辈人很少长时间打长途，他们脑袋中似乎有一个永远走着的表滴滴答答的提醒他们时间快到了，快点结束。

trans.cn: 对方付费电话
代收电话：指拨打电话的一方希望由被叫方承担通话费用的电话。过去，代收电话只能通过操作员辅助拨号进行，但随着基于计算机的电话拨号设备的引入，现在可以不使用操作员进行代收电话，这被称为自动操作员服务（AOS），与国内直拨（HCD）相对应。（自动代收拨号消除了只能在操作员辅助连接上提供的服务，而该服务需要更高的费用：人对人电话，除非有指定的人员可用，否则不收费。）。

sentences.c: "I want to make a collect call," she said as soon as a voice came on the line.
sentences.cn: “我想打个对方付费的电话，”她一听到电话里传来声音就说道。

sentences.c: A: I need to make a collect call.
sentences.cn: A：我得打个对方付费电话。

sentences.c: A collect call to America, please.
sentences.cn: 请接美国的对方付款电话。

sentences.c: Keep personal phone calls brief and few — and never take a call that will require a box of tissues to get through.

sentences.c: By extending the courtesy of a phone call to my clients, I was building a personal relationship with them.
sentences.cn: 通过给客户打电话这样有礼的行为，我渐渐和他们建立起私交。

sentences.c: The line is busy—I'll try again later.

trans.cn: 高级房

sentences.cn: 一辆区间往返公共汽车频繁地往来于小客栈与乡村俱乐部之间。

sentences.c: The re is a shuttle bus for Expo visitors.
sentences.cn: 有一辆为世博会参观者准备的往返班车。

sentences.c: I'll be taking their shuttle bus from the airport.
sentences.cn: 我要从机场乘坐他们班车。

trans.cn: 全价
全价：指主要或最高的价格。

sentences.c: We had to pay the full price in advance for an escorted tour.
sentences.cn: 我们必须提前付全款，才有导游陪同。

sentences.c: It should be told to think instead about charging a full price for using Heathrow, and the resulting excess profits at BAA should be taxed.
sentences.cn: 应该考虑对希思罗机场的使用收取全价，并对 BAA 由此产生的超额利润征税。

sentences.c: Buy any full price movie ticket on weekdays, you can buy a second ticket for a friend for only half price, or a second ticket for free on your birthday!
sentences.cn: 工作日购买任意全价电影票，只需半价即可为朋友购买第二张电影票，生日当天也可免费购买第二张电影票！

trans.cn: 折扣价
折扣价：商品在原价的基础上打折后的价格。

sentences.c: The page sold a package of very neat Mac OS X applications for a discounted price and for a limited time.
sentences.cn: 这个网站上会限时打折销售用于MacOS X操作系统一套非常简洁的应用程序包。

sentences.c: Buying a product at the discounted price you get with a coupon is certainly cheaper than paying full-price — no one's arguing with that concept.
sentences.cn: 使用优惠券以折扣价买一件商品当然要比付全额要便宜，没人质疑这一点。

sentences.c: The robots went on sale last month at $400, 000, or a discounted price of $280, 000 to a company or institution with a history of contributing to open-source projects.
sentences.cn: 此机器人上月开始对外销售，每个价值400 000美元，对于那些对开源项目作出过贡献的公司或机构可以280 000美元的折扣价购买。

trans.cn: 优惠价
特价：指某个商品或服务在一段时间内以较低的价格出售或提供。

sentences.c: I'll pay, but give me special price, please.
sentences.cn: 我会马上付款，但要给我特价。

sentences.c: The car salesmen said these cars will offer special price next month.
sentences.cn: 汽车销售员说这几款汽车下个月会有优惠活劫。

sentences.c: Partition dimension Regular price Each Special price Each (12 or more).
sentences.cn: 声音隔板规格每只常规价每只特别价(12及以上)。

trans.cn: 房间已满。
包括饮食。
餐食包括：指某个服务或安排所提供的餐食内容。

sentences.c: Are the meals included in the rent?
sentences.cn: 房租里包括膳食费吗？

sentences.c: Yes, it's full board, so all meals, and transport from the airport to your hotel. Everything is included.
sentences.cn: 是的，包括所有的食宿，从机场到酒店的交通费用，所有费用都包括在内。

sentences.c: All meals (two lunches, two dinners and breakfast) are included in the price of sleeping-car fares. All are served banquet-style in the dining or parlour cars.
sentences.cn: 卧铺票价包括所有用餐(早餐，两个午餐和两个晚餐)所有用餐都在餐车内，以自助形式提供。

快速行进的，快速移动的

sentences.cn: 她因超速行车被传讯。

sentences.c: The police caught him speeding.
sentences.cn: 警察发现他超速行驶。

sentences.c: She was fined for speeding.
sentences.cn: 她因超速而被罚款。

trans.cn: 售票处
候车室
等候室：（如医生办公室中的）供等候者（如病人）使用的房间。

sentences.c: We were shown into the waiting room.
sentences.cn: 我们被领进等候室。

sentences.c: Notices in the waiting room requested that you neither smoke nor spit.
sentences.cn: 等候室的告示要求人们不要吸烟也不要随地吐痰。

sentences.c: They had to wait in the waiting room.
sentences.cn: 他们不得不在等候室等候。

sentences.c: Carriage restorer Dave Evans cleans the Glass Coach at the Royal Mews in central London on March 21.
sentences.cn: 3月21日，伦敦，马车修缮师戴维·埃文斯在伦敦中心清理皇家马车的玻璃车厢。

sentences.c: He was in a coach with the hood let down and a carriage apron completely covering it.
sentences.cn: 载着他的是一辆轻便马车，车厢关得严严实实，车篷也放下了。

sentences.cn: 她想象着自己摔到路面上、骨头粉碎、弹滚到人行道上的情景。

trans.cn: 单行道
单行道：只允许交通单向行驶的道路。在比喻意义上，它也可以表示一种无法撤回或不会得到回报的行动方式。

sentences.c: From what I have been saying about the causes of pedodiversity, you might assume that the relationship between forest dynamics, what happens to the trees, and pedodiversity is a one-way street.
sentences.cn: 从我所说的形成土壤多样性的原因来看，你们可能会认为森林动态——即树木发生什么变化——和土壤多样性之间的关系是单向的。

sentences.c: The tourist wonders: Was it a one-way street?
sentences.cn: 旅游者感到奇怪的是：这是一条单行道吗？

sentences.c: Of course, communication cannot be a one-way street.
sentences.cn: 当然，交流不会是一个单行道。

trans.cn: 交通高峰时间
高峰时段：一天中交通或商业需求达到高峰的时段。

sentences.c: They run extra trains during the rush hour.
sentences.cn: 他们在车流高峰期加开了列车。

sentences.c: The traffic in the city is chaotic in the rush hour.
sentences.cn: 在上下班高峰时间，城市的交通混乱不堪。

sentences.c: I left early to avoid the rush hour.
sentences.cn: 我早早动身以避开交通高峰时刻。

trans.cn: 拥挤的交通
拥堵交通：指交通流量大、车辆密集的情况。

sentences.c: There was heavy traffic on the roads.
sentences.cn: 路上的交通很拥挤。

sentences.c: There is heavy traffic in the downtown area tonight.
sentences.cn: 今夜闹市区交通繁忙。

sentences.c: Rocco drove one mile in heavy traffic.
sentences.cn: 罗科在交通拥挤的情况下开了一英里。

trans.cn: 交通堵塞
交通堵塞：道路上长时间停滞或缓慢行驶的车辆排队现象。

sentences.c: We were stuck in a traffic jam.
sentences.cn: 我们遇上了交通阻塞。

sentences.c: She sat in the car, silently fuming at the traffic jam.
sentences.cn: 她坐在汽车里，心中对交通堵塞感到十分恼火。

sentences.c: The traffic jam soon cleared once the offending vehicle had been removed.
sentences.cn: 肇事车辆一经移走，交通拥堵现象很快就消除了。

trans.cn: 交通灯
红绿灯

sentences.c: Turn left at the traffic lights.
sentences.cn: 在交通信号灯处向左拐。

sentences.c: He pulled up at the traffic lights.
sentences.cn: 他在红绿灯处停了车。

sentences.c: The traffic lights were out of phase.
sentences.cn: 红绿灯信号不协调。

trans.cn: 交通规则
交通规则：指在道路上行驶时需要遵守的规定和法规，旨在确保交通安全和秩序。

sentences.c: The bus follows traffic rules.
sentences.cn: 公共汽车遵守交通规则。

sentences.c: We must follow traffic rules when crossing the street.
sentences.cn: 过马路时我们必须遵守交通规则。

sentences.c: You'll be punished if you break the traffic rules.
sentences.cn: 如果你违反交通规则，你将受到惩罚。

synos.cn: 交通法规；交通规则（traffic rule的复数）

trans.cn: 驾照
驾照

sentences.cn: 需要一个有驾照的人一直在车里吗？

sentences.c: The reason London taxi drivers are so efficient is that they all have gone through a very tough training period to get the special taxi driving license.
sentences.cn: 伦敦的出租车司机之所以效率这么高，是因为他们受到非常严格的训练才获得了专用出租车驾驶执照。

sentences.c: He doesn't have a driving license.
sentences.cn: 他没有驾驶执照。

sentences.c: It's always crowded at peak times.
sentences.cn: 在高峰期总是很拥挤。

sentences.c: The roads should be less crowded today.
sentences.cn: 今天路上该不那么拥挤了吧。

trans.cn: 乘飞机
坐公交
乘坐公共汽车：使用公共汽车作为交通工具。

sentences.c: They criss-crossed the country by bus.
sentences.cn: 他们乘坐公共汽车在乡间交叉往返。

sentences.c: You'd be better going by bus.
sentences.cn: 你坐公共汽车去会更好些。

sentences.c: Shall we walk or go by bus ?
sentences.cn: 我们步行呢，还是坐公共汽车？

trans.cn: 乘长途汽车
乘坐长途汽车：使用长途汽车作为交通工具。

sentences.c: Travel is by coach overnight to Berlin.
sentences.cn: 旅程为乘一夜长途汽车去柏林。

sentences.c: It used to take a fortnight to travel from London to Edingburgh by coach, however you can now travel many times around the world in that time.
sentences.cn: 过去，坐长途汽车从伦敦到爱丁堡需要两周的时间，但现在你可以在两周里多次环游世界。

sentences.c: He travelled a great deal by coach.
sentences.cn: 他坐马车作过不少旅行。

trans.cn: 坐船
乘船：使用船只作为交通工具。

sentences.c: He made a firm decision to leave Fort Multry by boat.
sentences.cn: 他作出了明确的决定，要乘船离开穆尔特里堡。

sentences.c: The first leg of the journey was by boat to Lake Naivasha in Kenya.
sentences.cn: 第一段旅程是坐船到肯尼亚的奈瓦夏湖。

sentences.c: They arrive by boat.
sentences.cn: 他们乘船到达。

trans.cn: 由陆路
陆路：通过陆地进行的交通或旅行。

sentences.c: We made the journey by land , though flying would have been cheaper.
sentences.cn: 虽然乘飞机会便宜些，我们还是走了陆路。

sentences.c: Some came by land and some by water.
sentences.cn: 一些人由旱路来，一些人从水路来。

sentences.c: They seem far too big to be surrounded by land.
sentences.cn: 仿佛是因为他们实在太大而无法被陆地包围似的。

trans.cn: 由海路
通过海运：通过船只的方式。

sentences.c: Antarctica is accessible by sea for a few weeks in summer and expeditions usually aimed to arrive in January or February.
sentences.cn: 在夏季的某几个星期，人们可以乘船到达南极洲，而极地考察通常在1月或2月进行。

sentences.c: Hotel "Crescent" will be like a "gateway" to those guests who arrive in the country by sea and symbolize the rapidly growing economy of Azerbaijan.
sentences.cn: “新月”酒店将成为那些从海上抵达阿塞拜疆的客人的“门户”，象征着阿塞拜疆经济的快速增长。

sentences.c: There is growing support for the theory that migration took place much earlier, by sea, following a coastal route along Alaska and down the northwest coast.
sentences.cn: 越来越多的人支持这样一种理论，即移民发生得要早得多，是沿着阿拉斯加沿海路线，沿西北海岸而下通过海路进行的。
